title: Laredo Author Jan Notzon’s Books Now on the Shelves at Barnes & Noble in Mall del Norte
excerpt: Laredo-born novelist and playwright Jan Notzon’s books are now available at the new Barnes & Noble at Mall del Norte, 5300 San Dario Ave., Suite 240. Readers who don’t see his titles on the shelf can ask a bookseller about ordering a copy.
content:
Laredo has its own acclaimed novelist and playwright — and now his books are on the shelves at the new Barnes & Noble at Mall del Norte.

Jan Notzon was born and raised in Laredo. He is the founder of the Laredo Little Theatre and has written seven full-length plays, a one-act play produced in New York City, and several novels, including “The Dogs...Barking,” “And Ye Shall Be As Gods” and “Only the Dead (Know the End of War),” which follows two Mexican families and one Anglo family during the formation of the Mexican and Texas republics.

Notzon’s work explores family, faith, identity and life on the Texas-Mexico border. He also appeared as an actor in television productions including “Matlock,” “The Young Indiana Jones Chronicles” and the Hallmark Channel’s “The Confession.”

He visited Texas A&M International University on Nov. 9 for a moderated conversation with students about his background, writing process and inspiration.

His books are now stocked at Barnes & Noble, Mall del Norte, 5300 San Dario Ave., Suite 240. If a title is not on the shelf, readers can ask a bookseller about ordering a copy.

Source: Texas A&M International University, Oct. 29, 2026.
